enchantments.tooltip: Thorn Guard +6: When you are hit or missed in combat, this item has a chance to deal 6d8 Piercing damage on hit.
Armor-Piercing 20%: Passive: +20% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Quality Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Strength.
Quality Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
